signal: Base de polices et empreinte nationale
story_fr: Erie Insurance compte pres de sept millions de polices en vigueur et opere dans 12 etats plus le District de Columbia, se classant 16e assureur dommages americain en primes nettes emises.
story_en: Erie Insurance has nearly seven million policies in force and operates in 12 states plus the District of Columbia, ranking as the 16th largest US property and casualty insurer by net premiums written.
quote: Rated A (Excellent) by AM Best, ERIE has nearly seven million policies in force and operates in 12 states and the District of Columbia.

story_fr: Le resultat operationnel avant impots des activites de gestion a progresse de 10,2% au T1 2026, soutenu par la croissance des honoraires d'emission et de renouvellement et une baisse des frais hors commissions.
story_en: Operating income before taxes from management operations grew 10.2% in Q1 2026, supported by growth in policy issuance and renewal fees and a decline in non-commission expenses.
quote: Operating income before taxes increased $15.4 million, or 10.2 percent, in the first quarter of 2026 compared to the first quarter of 2025.

story_fr: Erie Indemnity a verse une contribution de 100 millions de dollars a la fondation Erie Insurance creee en 2025, reduisant le benefice net du T4 2025 de 80,6 millions apres impots pour perenniser ses dons caritatifs.
story_en: Erie Indemnity made a $100 million contribution to the Erie Insurance Foundation formed in 2025, reducing Q4 2025 net income by $80.6 million after tax to create long-term sustainability for charitable giving.
quote: Net income was reduced by $80.6 million, or $1.54 per diluted share, in the fourth quarter and year ended December 31, 2025, reflecting the after-tax impact of a $100 million charitable contribution made to the Erie Insurance Foundation, a tax-exempt private charitable foundation formed in 2025.

story_fr: Les commissions ont augmente de 175,6 millions de dollars sur 2025, portees par la croissance des primes directes et assumees affiliees et par une meilleure rentabilite technique dommages sur trois ans.
story_en: Commissions increased $175.6 million in 2025, driven by growth in direct and affiliated assumed written premium and improved three-year property and casualty underwriting profitability.
quote: Commissions increased $175.6 million in 2025 compared to 2024, primarily driven by the growth in direct and affiliated assumed written premium and an increase in agent incentive compensation due to improved property and casualty underwriting profitability for the three-year period ended 2025 compare

story_fr: Les revenus d'investissement avant impots ont atteint 84,9 millions de dollars en 2025 contre 69,3 millions en 2024, soit une hausse de plus de 22%, refletant un meilleur rendement du portefeuille.
story_en: Investment income before taxes reached $84.9 million in 2025 versus $69.3 million in 2024, a rise of more than 22%, reflecting improved portfolio returns.
quote: Income from investments before taxes totaled $84.9 million in 2025 compared to $69.3 million in 2024. Net investment income was $85.8 million in 2025 compared to $70.2 million in 2024.
